entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: histogram-valued subquery set operator requires query eval-time context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: HTTP query handlers lower through LowerAt or LowerAtRange, so subqueryGridCtx returns before the subqueryGridUnavailable fallback; only the raw test and tooling Lower entry can omit an evaluation anchor. The rowsMayContainHistograms guard therefore protects that internal fallback from a lossy projection and is not wire-reachable.
